title: Allegedly AI-Generated Audio Bomb Threat Prompted Evacuations at the Port of Constanța, Romania
summary: A Romanian-language audio bomb threat, assessed by officials as AI-generated, prompted employee evacuations and security searches at the Port of Constanța, Romania. Authorities received two calls using numbers with Ukrainian and Polish prefixes. Officials later said the alert was false. The perpetrators and AI system were not identified.
